artifacts.base_model.repository.rationale: The public adapter names the model family with different repository casing, so this canonical repository name belongs to the pinned reconstruction candidate.

artifacts.base_model.revision.rationale: The public adapter records no base revision, so the named immutable public candidate is used.

artifacts.tokenizer.repository.rationale: The tokenizer is pinned to the named base candidate because the source-study tokenizer identity is unavailable.

artifacts.tokenizer.revision.rationale: The tokenizer revision follows the named base candidate because the source-study revision is unavailable.

artifacts.training_sample.identity_schem.rationale: Stable source-revision plus orig_idx identities are useful for replay, but the public evidence does not prove orig_idx is the source row offset.

adapter.bias.rationale: The bound adapter-config file contains this setting, but the public recipe receipt records only its file hash rather than the parsed bias value.

data.max_sequence_length.rationale: The source post names an 8192-token filter, but the producing sequence policy is unavailable.

data.overlength_policy.rationale: Dropping overlength examples is chosen because the source post describes an 8192-token filter.

data.packing.rationale: Packing is chosen because the observed token trace is consistent with nearly full 8192-token sequences.

data.truncation.rationale: Truncation is disabled to keep the named overlength-drop policy unambiguous.

data.append_eos.rationale: A single EOS is required after each assistant response by the named rendering contract.

data.shuffle.rationale: The public artifacts do not recover data order, so deterministic shuffling is named explicitly.

data.data_seed.rationale: Seed 42 is a named deterministic reconstruction because the initial source seed is unavailable.

data.loss_mask.rationale: Assistant-only loss is chosen for the SFT response objective because the source loss mask is unavailable.

optimization.optimizer.rationale: AdamW is named because the public artifacts do not expose the configured optimizer.

optimization.learning_rate.rationale: The configured value is chosen to match the observed peak learning rate without claiming source recovery.

optimization.betas.rationale: Default AdamW betas are named because optimizer arguments are unavailable.

optimization.epsilon.rationale: The AdamW epsilon is named because optimizer arguments are unavailable.

optimization.weight_decay.rationale: Zero weight decay is named because optimizer arguments are unavailable.

optimization.max_grad_norm.rationale: Gradient clipping at one is named because trainer arguments are unavailable.

optimization.scheduler.rationale: A linear scheduler is chosen to reproduce the observed trace shape without claiming the source scheduler.

optimization.warmup_steps.rationale: Five warmup steps are chosen because the observed learning-rate trace peaks at step five.

training.seed.rationale: Seed 42 is named because the public final RNG state does not recover the initial seed.

training.per_device_train_batch_size.rationale: Per-device batch two is chosen because the observed trainer batch field does not recover batch topology.

training.gradient_accumulation_steps.rationale: Four accumulation steps are chosen because the public artifacts do not recover accumulation.

training.world_size.rationale: Eight devices are chosen to make the named global batch consistent with the observed token trace.

training.effective_batch_size.rationale: Global batch 64 is chosen because it is consistent with the observed tokens per update under packing.

training.precision.rationale: Bfloat16 is chosen because the public artifacts do not record training precision.

training.gradient_checkpointing.rationale: Gradient checkpointing is enabled as a memory-feasible named training choice.

checkpointing.save_every_steps.rationale: A 25-step cadence is named because checkpoint cadence is unavailable.

checkpointing.save_optimizer.rationale: Optimizer state is required for the named exact-resume contract.

checkpointing.save_scheduler.rationale: Scheduler state is required for the named exact-resume contract.

checkpointing.save_rng.rationale: RNG state is required for the named exact-resume contract.

checkpointing.resume_mode.rationale: Exact verified resume is chosen so interruption cannot silently change training.

checkpointing.post_resume_absolute_toler.rationale: A 1e-6 tolerance is named before scientific training to fail closed on resume drift.

runtime.huggingface_hub.rationale: The locked implementation runtime is pinned because the source runtime is unavailable.

runtime.tokenizers.rationale: The locked tokenizer runtime is pinned because rendering depends on it and the source version is unavailable.

runtime.torch.rationale: The locked implementation runtime is pinned because the source runtime is unavailable.

runtime.transformers.rationale: The locked implementation runtime is pinned because the source runtime is unavailable.

limitations: The public candidate uses rank 32 while the source post reports rank 64.
The bounded smoke uses synthetic shape fixtures and a reduced randomly initialized model; full-sample loading and distributed precision remain later gates.
The bounded smoke verifies mechanics and does not authorize or claim scientific training.
